* '''PC-E1''' ([[Asajj Ventress (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 1, file created 17 June 2023: “Deploys -1 if Dooku on table. Whenever a player loses a battle here, that player loses 1 Force. While armed, opponent's weapon destiny draws targeting Ventress are -1. Opponent may not cancel battles here. Immune to [Permanent Weapon] weapons and attrition &lt; 4.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Asajj Ventress]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Asajj Ventress]] (published 18 June 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Asajj Ventress”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
